data.title: 雷姆 · 雨夜告白
data.description: 【雷姆 · 雨夜告白】暴雨倾盆的王都钟楼下，被泪水与雨水浸湿的雷姆紧紧握着昴的手，哪怕面对全世界的放弃与绝望，她依然绽放出世间最美丽的笑容——「就算所有人都放弃了昴君，雷姆也绝对不会放弃！从这里开始吧……从一……不，从零开始！」
data.location: 王都钟楼下的雨夜街口
data.action: 在钟楼下回望，雨声如诉
data.promptProse: Beneath the rain-swept royal-capital clock tower, Rem looks back with tearful blue eyes and an earnest expression as she addresses the viewer. Her soft casual off-duty outfit remains around the shoulders in the close-up. A near masonry pier overlaps the darker tower recess, while a narrow opening shows rain over the street beyond. The existing warm streetlight catches the tears and the nearer blue hair strands; cool reflected night-sky light softly separates the opposite side of her face from the stone. Rain streaks crossing the darker recess remain visible without turning the scene into daylight.
